result.description:
About the Role and Practice  

 Our client is a family oriented private billing practice who takes pride in delivering the best possible patient outcomes to their local Gordon community and surrounding North Shore suburbs. Due to not having enough doctors to cater for their heavy patient traffic and causing them to turn patients away everyday, a vocationally registered GP is needed to join their team on a permanent basis. General medical services offered here include age-specific health assessments, reproductive health,  travel medicine, post-natal care, skin checks, occupational health, spirometry and heart function tests, chronic disease management, childhood vaccinations, minor procedures and wound care.  This position would suit a GP who has a passion for chronic disease management and care plans as a practice nurse is available full-time to assist. A recall system is in place to remind patients to come back for important routine consultations and pathology facilities are open weekday mornings until lunchtime.  

 *The ability to speak a second language will be a huge advantage but not essential.  

  Core Operating Hours  

 
	 Weekdays: 8:00am  - 5:30pm 
	 Saturday: 9:00am - 1:00pm 
 

  Essential Criteria:  

 
	 MBBS or equivalent 
	 Minimum AHPRA GENERAL /SPECIALIST registration 
	 FRACGP qualified 
	 A good attitude towards teamwork 
   Apply Now

Located in the bustling Westfield Shopping Centre north of Canberra, this leading medical practice is home to a professional team of doctors, registered nurses, and a full-time practice manager. Committed to delivering quality healthcare services, the clinic offers a wide range of services, including vaccinations, health assessments, and comprehensive skin cancer checks. 

 With one female GP having recently relocated to Melbourne, the clinic is now seeking a new General Practitioner to join their team. The incoming GP can expect 65% of billings and a busy schedule with around 30 patients per day. To ensure a smooth transition, the clinic guarantees an income of $7,000 per week for the first eight weeks, based on a 40-hour workweek. 

 The clinic operates Monday to Friday from 8:30 am to 5:30 pm, and on Saturdays from 9:00 am to 2:00 pm. Ample parking is available, making it convenient for both patients and staff. This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established practice with a strong patient base and a supportive team in a prime Canberra location. 

 This practice is currently in a DPA location for any VR doctors still within their moratorium period    Apply Now

About the Role:  

 A full time or part time VR GP is sought out for a busy dynamic practice located about 30 mins from Adelaide. The clinic is a well-established and reputable healthcare facility located in the lively region of the City of Salisbury . With a strong team of GP's and nursing support, they provide comprehensive medical services to our diverse patient population. Their commitment to high-quality patient care is evident in our holistic approach and dedication to building long-lasting relationships with our patients.  You are invited to work in a state-of-the-art clinic equipped with the latest medical technology and equipment, ensuring a comfortable and efficient work environment.  

 Join a team of 10 GPs,  with 2x GPs leaving the practice to return overseas there is an opportunity to claim replacement DPA status for this position. You will be busy from day 1. The practice is offering 75% of billings with $180 retainer for a 3 month period.  

  About the practice:  
 
Their state-of-the-art facility boasts a modern design, featuring seven consulting rooms and a treatment room capable of accommodating two patients. They utilise the Best Practice software for efficient operations. You'll have the support of three qualified Registered Nurses, with two nurses specialising in chronic disease management and one nurse dedicated to the treatment room. Our onsite services include Multidisciplinary Allied Health and Pathology, ensuring comprehensive care for our patients. Additionally, there's a pharmacy and dentist conveniently located across the road.  

  
 About you:  

 
	 Must have a current and valid AHPRA GENERAL /SPECIALIST registration 
	 Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills 
	 Vocational Registration (FRACGP | FACRRM | FRNZCGP) 
	 Full Australian Work Rights 
	 General Practice experience in Australia 
	 Passion and commitment to providing a high level of care to patients 
	 A strong passion and commitment to delivering high-quality care is also a must 
 

  What's On Offer:  

 75% of billings on offer with $180 per hour retainer for 3 months.       Apply Now
